method: Replace exactly the final original response-instruction paragraph with one common constrained Choice instruction; all preceding facts/options byte-identical; same operation in V/N/U
original_instructions: Assess the available choices and select the warranted option. Return Choice, Trade-off and Reason only. Choice contains the action ID alone; Reason states the policy status. Identify genuine unresolved conditions without making conditional replies the default.

Choose between the stated options and explain the relevant consequences. Format the response as Choice / Trade-off / Reason. Keep Choice to the action ID and state normative force in Reason; do not confuse recommendation, permission and obligation.

Give the justified decision using these facts and available options. Use the three fields Choice, Trade-off and Reason, with a bare action ID and a policy-status statement inside Reason. Explain a real unresolved condition only when it prevents a definite choice.

What should be selected in this bounded decision? Provide Choice, Trade-off and Reason. Use the action ID in Choice and policy status in Reason. Give a concrete decision when the facts and policy settle it, retaining only genuine uncertainty.

Which option should be chosen on these facts? Use exactly Choice / Trade-off / Reason. Put the bare action ID in Choice and policy status in Reason. Distinguish required from recommended; use Conditional or Undetermined only for a genuinely missing fact or ethical commitment.

Use Conditional or Undetermined only for a genuinely missing fact or ethical commitment. Do not include a trade-off or reason.
